messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: unusual smart-routing behavior detected — elevated variant_mismatch rate across eu-west and us-east. Alert: variant_mismatch >= 5% for 4m. Incident created INC-2027.

maya (oncall): ack, joining. any initial clues?

eli (sre): looking. decision stream shows a surge of `fallback_decision` events where `route_tag` is blank for many entries. that should never happen.

joanna (eng-platform): we pushed a policy-service config change ~25m ago (v1.8.4). pulling the canary diff now.

sam (support): receiving tickets: customers reporting responses from smaller models, quality drop. collecting examples.

eli (sre): sample from decision log (raw):
```json
{"request_id":"r_f12e","region":"us-east","policy":"smart-fallback","selected_variant":"redwood-small-1","decisions":[{"reason":"fallback_capacity","chosen":true}],"timestamp":"2026-11-03T14:05:12Z"}
```
Note: no `route_tag` or `original_variant`; can't map why policy chose fallback.

joanna (eng-platform): found it. an ENV flag `STRIP_DECISION_METADATA=true` was enabled in the canary. it strips some metadata for serialization perf. looks accidental.

maya (oncall): can we flip it off?

joanna (eng-platform): initiating rollback to set `STRIP_DECISION_METADATA=false` across canary and then remainder. starting staging.

ops-bot: deploy started: policy-service config rollback by joanna. CI 4240.

eli (sre): while that's in flight, proposal: set smart-fallback `fallback_threshold=0` to prevent downgrading variants until metadata restored. low-risk and reversible.

joanna (eng-platform): applying threshold change to eu-west and us-east now.

ops-bot: config patch applied: eu-west fallback_threshold=0.
ops-bot: config patch applied: us-east fallback_threshold=0.

sam (support): update: some customers already see better outputs after threshold change, others still affected. I'm pushing CS notices to impacted accounts.

maya (oncall): eli, can you run a quick replay to enumerate requests that hit fallback due to missing metadata? we need request_ids for support.

eli (sre): on it. replaying last 40m. correlation: missing route_tag -> selected_variant in {small variants} in 98% of cases. extracting sample ids.

joanna (eng-platform): rollback canary completed, remainder rollout starting. also enabling `DETAILED_DECISION_LOGGING=true` for the next 45m so we can verify tags return.

ops-bot: feature toggles updated. detailed logging enabled.

eli (sre): seeing route_tag return in the stream. samples now include `route_tag` and `original_variant`. verifying mapping.

sam (support): posting impacted customers + requests: AC-210: r_f12e, AC-211: r_f13f, AC-215: r_f14g. CS template posted.

maya (oncall): handoff in 25m. eli will take next shift?

eli (sre): taking handoff. I'll keep monitoring and will prepare a short incident summary. adding alert for `missing_route_tag_rate > 0.3%`.

chris (product): summary note: root cause = accidental metadata strip toggle in canary config -> missing route_tag -> policy evaluation couldn't attribute rules correctly -> fallback chosen incorrectly -> customers received smaller models.

joanna (eng-platform): remediation actions: revert flag (done), add unit tests to prevent stripping critical fields (PR 2991), add canary gate that checks for preserved metadata keys before promoting.

eli (sre): follow-ups: add metric for `route_tag_missing_rate`, alert threshold, and a short-lived audit log export for any future gaps.

sam (support): will consolidate customer impact and next steps in CS doc; linking after I finish.

maya (oncall): marking INC-2027 MONITORED and handing to eli for follow-up. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: INC-2027 status set to MONITORED by maya (oncall).

eli (sre): final thread note: mitigations applied = rollback strip flag, set fallback_threshold=0, enabled detailed logging, added alerts. planned follow-ups = tests & deploy guard (joanna), alerting & audit export (eli), customer communications (sam).

joanna (eng-platform): will schedule a post-deploy verification check in 48h and include remediation ETA in PR.

sam (support): will post customer impact summary link in this thread when ready.

maya (oncall): closing handoff. please reopen if anything spikes.

ops-bot: INC-2027 updated: owner=joanna, severity=SEV3, state=MONITORED.
